prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 80.4%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 87.4%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 67.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 89.6%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 27.7%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Account Session Recovery Warning Hint: Add a security warning banner on the sign-in screen explaining how signing into a different account overwrites local pet profiles. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or reset after signing in again with a different account.)
1: [home, wait_info] Live Pet Spawning Status Feed: Display live status feed updates for pet asset rendering, audio setup, and desktop placement during the waiting screen. (why: Home waiting screen has a high mean time (2336s) and drop-off, leaving users uncertain if creation is frozen.)
2: [finish, copy] Desktop Control Overview Summary Copy: Update the home_intro summary copy to explicitly outline desktop dragging, system tray minimizing, and chat commands. (why: Users submitted multiple support tickets post-onboarding expressing confusion on how to minimize or talk to their desktop pet.)
3: [adoption, layout] Pet Friend Selection Grid Layout: Reconfigure the pick_friend screen into a visual grid layout displaying pet choices with animated preview cards. (why: The adoption stage drops 32.1% of users, pointing to friction when browsing starter companions.)
4: [home, notification] Background Completion Desktop System Sound Notification: Enable desktop audio chime notification when pet creation completes on the waiting screen to notify users who switched windows. (why: The median wait time is 201s and mean is 2336s, indicating users switch to other applications while waiting.)

scores.note: Addresses account overwrite issue noted in support emails, though sign-in already has high completion.
High mean wait time on home indicates users think app frozen; status feed reduces drop-off.
Finish step loses 35.2% of users and support tickets confirm post-onboarding desktop control confusion.
Adoption has a 32.1% drop-off; visual grid layout makes companion selection significantly smoother.
Large gap between median and mean home time indicates users tab away; chime alerts them when done.
